correctness.rationale: For odd-indexed q=2^k (k≥2), elementary Ramanujan sums give AA*=A*A=K=(I-T)/2, A²=KR, A⁴=K. Thus zero is half-dimensional and nonzero eigenvalues are fourth roots. At q=4 and 8 the direct quadratic trace isolates i^b and the cos/sin(πb/4) signs; for k≥4, pairing odd x with x+2^{k-2} cancels tr A and fixed-point-free reflection gives tr A²=0, enforcing four equal multiplicities 2^{k-4}. Standard odd-primary Ramanujan and quadratic Gauss-sum traces reconstruct the published odd local factors. CRT with b_j(N/q_j)≡1 mod q_j yields a permutation similarity, product eigenvalues and projectors, rank and positive-singular-value conditioning. Independent NumPy diagonalization for q=2..128 and b=1,3,5,7 matched every listed multiplicity and Gram identity; finite samples are not the all-k proof.
